checkpoint.resumeInstruction: 1) wugs-s6 is fully done (merged, DoD written, pipeline-state.json at definition-of-done). One open, non-blocking follow-up remains: the operator should run artefacts/2026-08-11-web-ui-guardrails-standards-surface/reference/wugs-s6-manual-verification.md's procedure when convenient, and the outcome should be recorded back into decisions.md's RISK-ACCEPT entry + PR #726's comment thread (https://github.com/heymishy/skills-repo/pull/726#issuecomment-5271972819) once done -- check whether this has happened before assuming it's still open. 2) Next: start the inner loop for wugs-s3 (next in the corrected sequence: wugs-s3 -> wugs-s7 -> wugs-s4 -> wugs-s8 -> wugs-s9 -> wugs-s10 -> wugs-s11 -> wugs-s12), following the exact same branch-setup -> implementation-plan -> subagent-execution -> verify-completion -> branch-complete -> DoD cycle used for wugs-s1/s2/s5/s6. Note wugs-s3's own AC1 has a cross-epic dependency on wugs-s6 (now satisfied) per the SLICE decision logged 2026-08-11 in decisions.md. 3) IMPORTANT process learnings from wugs-s6, apply to all remaining stories: (a) when resuming any story whose worktree already exists, do NOT trust a stale checkpoint's task-count as ground truth -- read the actual implementation plan's task list against `git log --oneline` in the worktree AND separately check `git status` for uncommitted work; a background agent can legitimately outrun the last checkpoint write, and completed-but-uncommitted work is a distinct failure mode from incomplete work, requiring both checks to tell apart. (b) A DoR's REQUIRED pre-merge manual step is not mechanically enforced by any gate today -- nothing blocks merge without it, only a markdown checkbox in the PR description. If any of the remaining 8 stories' DoRs have a similar REQUIRED manual step, proactively confirm it was actually performed (ask the operator directly) before treating branch-complete or merge as satisfying it -- do not assume a merged PR means every DoR requirement was met. 4) For every pipeline-state.json write: fetch origin/master first and compare against the worktree's own base commit before writing directly -- if no drift, safe to write the worktree's local copy directly (true for every write this session). Nested array fields (e.g. tasks[N].tddState) are NOT supported by `skills advance`'s single-level dot-notation -- these require a direct, careful Edit, followed immediately by `node scripts/check-pipeline-state-integrity.js` to confirm no new failures were introduced (14 pre-existing unrelated failures are baseline-normal, confirmed twice this session). Also note: `dodStatus` only accepts 'not-started' | 'complete' per the integrity checker's enum -- record deviation detail in the DoD artefact's prose (Outcome section), not by inventing a non-enum dodStatus value like 'complete-with-deviations' (two other features in this repo already have that exact integrity failure baseline -- don't add a third). Baseline test count to expect throughout: 33 pre-existing failures out of 510 files (documented in decisions.md's repeated RISK-ACCEPT entries) -- confirm this hasn't changed before assuming any new failure is pre-existing.
